replays.verification_json: exact byte-for-byte reproduction of all six final rows

review_notes: 19C8C preserves the three real byte inputs, live count and post-helper reloads, chain sentinel retry, identifier sequencing, and final publication. Unsigned pitch shifting and bounded signed detune multiplication avoid signed overflow and negative-shift undefined behavior.

D1F4 has ten independently evidenced arguments and a 68-byte O32 emitter. Five calculator output pointers are distinct; a zero first output exits before reading conditionally unwritten pan/span/send values. Both wrappers corroborate the ten slots. Allocation failures and live final handle are retained.

DC08 has no input arguments; its only direct boot-tail caller is 8001DDE0. The 12-byte groups and 28-byte entries, cached external D_8002D904/D_8002D908 values, counter wrapping, callback reloads and failure/success flag logic agree with the complete native body.
Source forms remain natural C89; no fake formals, padding locals, assembly, extra helper bodies, masked equality or source-size inflation were found.

All claims remain within valid registered storage, bounded lists, genuine helper contracts and ordinary floating-point domains. Host tests are logical callback-double tests, not target execution or whole playback validation.
